title: LiveCodeBench score with a vendor/independent discrepancy — contest + loop

reasons: The exact vendor-reported score is well established: full DeepSeek-R1 = 65.9 LiveCodeBench Pass@1-COT, in DeepSeek's arXiv Table 3 at https://arxiv.org/html/2501.12948, and the table separates R1-Zero and R1-Dev stages.
The official LiveCodeBench leaderboard backend is still unresolved: the analysis cannot establish whether full DeepSeek-R1 is present or absent in the underlying leaderboard data.
Independent corroboration or refutation of the 65.9 score is absent; the only named independent source, BenchLM, neither lists DeepSeek-R1 nor bears on the 65.9 figure.
R1-Distill separation is missing, so the variant-separation success criterion is incomplete.
No contradiction in the evidence was found, but multiple explicit success criteria remain unmet; targeted additional research can plausibly close them.
A numeric score and metric are documented from a primary vendor source: 65.9 Pass@1-COT, DeepSeek arXiv Table 3, https://arxiv.org/html/2501.12948, satisfying criterion 1.
Official leaderboard verification is incomplete: the raw JSON files backing livecodebench.github.io are identified but not row-level searched, and absence is explicitly not established.
Independent corroboration or refutation is absent: BenchLM, Artificial Analysis, and Papers with Code neither confirm nor refute the score, while the Hugging Face card is vendor-affiliated.
Variant separation is partial: DeepSeek-R1-Zero and R1-Dev scores are separated, but DeepSeek-R1-Distill LiveCodeBench scores were not collected.
